import React, { useEffect, useState } from "react"; import { useNavigate } from "react-router-dom"; import "./ProfileSummary.css"; const ProfileSummary = () => { const navigate = useNavigate(); const [userProfile, setUserProfile] = useState(null); const loadProfile = () => { fetch("http://localhost:5000/userProfile") .then((response) => { if (!response.ok) { throw new Error("Failed to load profile"); } return response.json(); }) .then((data) => { setUserProfile(data); }) .catch((error) => { console.log(error); alert("Error loading profile details"); }); }; useEffect(() => { loadProfile(); }, []); const handleEdit = (path) => { navigate(path, { state: { editMode: true } }); }; if (!userProfile) { return (

Profile Summary

Loading your profile details...

); } return (
{/* Header */}

Profile Summary

Review your submitted profile details

{/* Create Profile */}

Create Profile

First Name {userProfile.createProfile?.firstName || "-"}
Last Name {userProfile.createProfile?.lastName || "-"}
Email {userProfile.createProfile?.email || "-"}
Email Status {userProfile.createProfile?.emailVerified ? "Verified" : "Not Verified"}
{/* Aadhaar & PAN */}

Aadhaar & PAN Details

Aadhaar

Aadhaar Number {userProfile.kycDetails?.aadhaar?.aadhaarNumber || "-"}
Name {userProfile.kycDetails?.aadhaar?.name || "-"}
Date of Birth {userProfile.kycDetails?.aadhaar?.dateOfBirth || "-"}
Document {userProfile.kycDetails?.aadhaar?.document || "Not uploaded"}

PAN

PAN Number {userProfile.kycDetails?.pan?.panNumber || "-"}
Name {userProfile.kycDetails?.pan?.name || "-"}
Document {userProfile.kycDetails?.pan?.document || "Not uploaded"}
{/* GST */}

GST Details

GST Number {userProfile.gstDetails?.gstNumber || "-"}
Legal Name {userProfile.gstDetails?.legalName || "-"}
Business Type {userProfile.gstDetails?.businessType || "-"}
Registration Number {userProfile.gstDetails?.registrationNumber || "-"}
Business Address {userProfile.gstDetails?.businessAddress || "-"}
{/* Bank */}

Bank Details

Account Number {userProfile.bankDetails?.accountNumber || "-"}
Account Holder Name {userProfile.bankDetails?.holderName || "-"}
IFSC Code {userProfile.bankDetails?.ifscCode || "-"}
Branch Address {userProfile.bankDetails?.branchAddress || "-"}
{/* Agreement */}

Agreement

Agreement Status {userProfile.agreement?.accepted ? "Accepted" : "Not Accepted"}
); }; export default ProfileSummary;
